WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ÁUDIO

O que fazemos

Melhoramos o nível de qualidade do áudio em todos os títulos e tecnologias de jogos da Epic, além de trabalharmos com uma equipe de qualidade internacional para criar experiências de jogo impressionantes.

O que você fará

Como membro da equipe de áudio da Epic, você usará suas habilidades técnicas e criativas ao máximo, ajudando a definir o futuro da tecnologia de áudio interativa.

Nessa função, você irá

  • Criar e implementar assets de áudio para vários assets importantes do Fortnite com alta qualidade
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de áudio, arte e design para solucionar problemas e implementar soluções
  • Utilizar blueprints da UE5, MetaSounds e assets de dados para conectar e testar assets de áudio
  • Avaliar a mixagem de áudio e a implementação de assets de áudio no jogo e ajustar de acordo com os padrões e as necessidades do jogo
  • Gerenciar e priorizar as tarefas atribuídas, com foco em atingir as metas dentro do prazo
  • Ter amplo conhecimento das técnicas de gravação em campo e das bibliotecas de sons disponíveis

O que estamos procurando

  • Projetar, editar, mixar, masterizar e implementar conteúdo para mídia interativa e linear em prazos apertados
  • Sólida competência básica em pelo menos uma das principais DAWs, com sólidos conhecimentos de engenharia de áudio focados em Foley e técnicas de gravação em campo
  • Familiaridade com técnicas de gravação, edição e processamento de VO
  • Altamente automotivado, com fortes habilidades de comunicação e organização; capaz de gerenciar tarefas e prioridades de forma independente
  • Experiência com Unreal, Unity e/ou mecanismos de jogos proprietários, incluindo scripts, editor de níveis, animação e editores lineares
  • Experiência com middleware de áudio e implementação de assets de áudio em compilações de jogos
  • Capacidade de colaborar com várias áreas para criar um áudio eficaz
  • Capacidade de projetar e implementar scripts de áudio para obter os recursos de áudio desejados no jogo e a reprodução dinâmica
  • Capaz de solucionar problemas de áudio, além de otimizar e atender à alocação de memória e aos requisitos de desempenho em várias plataformas

Benefícios

Pagamos 100% de benefícios tanto para funcionários quanto para dependentes. Nosso pacote de benefícios atual inclui cobertura para seguro médico, odontológico e de vida. Também oferecemos benefícios complementares, incluindo vales-refeição diários e benefícios de transporte para funcionários locais.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Sobre a Bevap Bioenergia

A Bevap Bioenergia é uma companhia brasileira especializada no setor de bioenergia, focando na produção de etanol, açúcar e eletricidade utilizando a cana-de-açúcar como matéria-prima. Sua atuação abrange todas as etapas do processo produtivo, desde o cultivo da cana até a fabricação e distribuição dos produtos finais, destacando-se pela sua abordagem integrada.

Sobre o Trainee Bevap

O Programa de Trainee da Bevap Bioenergia é ideal para jovens talentos que procuram desafios e desejam impulsionar suas carreiras. Adicionalmente, os participantes têm acesso a mentoria individual fornecida por executivos da Bevap , garantindo orientação e apoio para seu desenvolvimento profissional. Este programa visa preparar os trainees para assumirem futuras posições de liderança dentro da organização.

Establish methodology to manage production capacity based on forecasted demand. Optimize efficiency and minimize cost. Lead SLOB processes and corrective actions. Align best practices and training within the region. Manage Raw material long term requirements, contracting and allocation process. Support transfers between sites.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Work in close collaboration with GBS, customer care, demand planning, raw material planning and planning streams/systems to ensure service level to customers
  • Optimize supply network; balance capacity and inventory across the supply network
  • Propose and drive processes/ways of working for more efficiency and reduced cost
  • Project Management
  • Review slow moving and obsolete inventory. Manage reserve projections.
  • Drive inventory policies and planning parameters
  • Develop and improve reports and tools
  • Monitor critical supply constraints & escalate supply issues
  • Product life cycle management; review changes to existing business, new / lost business, and review formulation changes to mitigate risk
  • Contribute to transfers within the region and across regions

  • Accountable for Site, technology or Regional Supply Reviews

Your professional profile includes:

  • Strong working knowledge in planning. preferably has experience with demand, supply and production
  • Escalations, allocation programs, capacity balancing
  • Working knowledge BI, BO.
  • Thorough understanding and experience with SAP
  • Language Skills: English and other language(s) as required
  • Project management
  • Bachelor's Degree or Related Experience in Supply Chain Management

Our benefits include:

At Givaudan, you work within an inspiring teamwork culture – where you can thrive, collaborate and learn from other talented and passionate people across disciplines, regions and divisions. Every essence of you enriches our world.

title: ELETRICISTA ESPECIALIZADO
description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  • Executar inspeções periódicas nos equipamentos elétricos dos armazéns, identificando e corrigindo possíveis falhas ou desgastes.
  • Realizar testes de funcionamento e calibração dos sistemas elétricos, garantindo o seu desempenho adequado.
  • Realizar reparos e substituições de componentes, cabos, disjuntores, fusíveis e outros dispositivos elétricos conforme necessário.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas elétricos em equipamentos de armazenagem, como transportadores, elevadores, esteiras, sistemas de iluminação, painéis elétricos, entre outros.
  • Registrar todas as atividades de manutenção realizadas, incluindo intervenções, substituições, ajustes e testes, utilizando os sistemas ou ferramentas adequadas.
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos colaboradores e usuários dos equipamentos elétricos, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo orientações e instruções de uso adequado.

Qualificações

  • Curso: Eletricista de Manutenção Industrial ou Técnico Eletrotécnica e/ou Elétrica

Informações adicionais

  • Disponibilidade de viagens.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

description:
You’ll collaborate closely with the Business Development and global sales team, gathering client materials, assisting with internal sales requests, and building prospect lists to perform daily follow-up and support tasks. You'll be trained in our CRM and support tools while engaging with team members across different time zones via email, Slack, and video calls. As you grow, you'll interact with existing clients and partners of the global business.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain relationships within client organizations.
  • Serve as a contact for prospective existing and client needs and partner strategy.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Licensing, Product, Technology, Marketing, Content, and Revenue teams.
  • Support distribution strategies and identify new growth opportunities.
  • Stay knowledgeable about client business and the technology industry.
  • Advocate for client needs within OTTera.

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years in strategic partnerships, business development, or consulting.
  • Experience with external partners and complex organizations.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting to executives.
  • Proactive and team-oriented with a growth mindset.

Preferred:

  • Knowledge of OTT and FAST streaming platforms.
  • Understanding of marketing and distribution for clients.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office or Google Docs.

About OTTera:

Founded in 2017, OTTera is a dynamic player in the streaming video space. We offer PaaS technical products of white label OTT/video streaming applications, live/linear playback (FAST channels), and AdOps/RevOps/monetization services. We directly power 90+ brands, over 300+ linear channels and deliver content to an audience of hundreds of millions of users worldwide. Our core team has been working in this space for 12 years and has the connections, knowhow, and momentum to continue to grow our business at ever-increasing speed.

We need new individuals to join our team to help bring new ideas to the table, provide muscle and bandwidth to execute on existing initiatives, and to be a part of this challenging and constantly evolving landscape. Come help us shape the future of content and disrupt the industry with our agile approach, strategic vision, and deep, earned knowledge of the space.

We have team members working around the world and have been virtual since the company was formed. Our core team is located in Los Angeles.

Culture:

We pride ourselves on diversity, and working with a worldwide team of people from different backgrounds. We have a very collaborative engineering team — we have formal standups twice a week, but also frequent informal standups and rubber-duck sessions to help chat through those sticky little issues we all run into.

This is a fast-paced, dynamic environment — there are a lot of moving parts and a lot of different initiatives going on at once. Looking for folks that are organized, flexible, able to self-direct, ask the necessary questions, and help us keep building this amazing rocket as we’re flying it!

description:
Join to apply for the TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM - SALA VERMELHA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde .

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar os procedimentos e assistência de sua responsabilidade, preenchendo registros específicos da Assistência de Enfermagem, conforme orientação do Enfermeiro, acolhendo os pacientes de modo que sejam atendidos continuamente em suas necessidades.

Requisitos e qualificações

  1. Curso Técnico de Enfermagem completo;
  2. Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função;
  3. Registro ativo no conselho de classe.

description:
Company Description

At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 110 offices worldwide.

Job Description

To help us deliver projects to our clients, we are looking for a qualified Cost Manager to join our flourishing Real Estate Business. You will be overseeing front end construction within the property sector, for build projects such as sports and leisure, new residential builds, office new builds and fit out, healthcare, and education.

Your role will be to perform the role of the Commission Manager, taking responsibility for end to end service delivery and ensuring that client objectives are met through the delivery of an effective cost management service. Your responsibilities will encompass a variety of commission management, marketing and business development, and internal management capabilities.

Key Aspects Of The Role Include

  • Knowledge Management, Financial Management, Process Management
  • Assisting on feasibility studies and writing procurement reports
  • Estimating and cost planning to include producing and presenting the final cost plan
  • Tendering and procuring
  • Cost checks and carrying out valuations
  • Cost reports
  • Inputting into value engineering
  • Negotiating and agreeing final accounts
  • Interfacing with the client and other consultants, at all project stages
  • Where appropriate, leading a cost management team, ensuring that they deliver on all of the above accountabilities
  • Identifying opportunities to develop new business with existing clients
  • Assisting in the production of bid documentation

At Turner & Townsend we utilise market leading Cost Management technology, to ensure we are fully equipped to create value and achieve the best solutions for our clients. We work collaboratively with our clients to be innovative and lead change in the market. We work in a supportive environment with clear direction and progression paths.

Qualifications

  • Graduated in Engineering or Architecture
  • Full membership of the RICS (MRICS), ACostE or equivalent professional qualification
  • Cost Management experience within the build construction arena, ideally within property and real estate sectors
  • An analytical thinker, open to learning from others
  • Ability to be client facing and focused
  • Drive, passion and decisiveness, a high performer with an ability to work in a high pressured environment

Additional Information

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

description:
Quem somos?

A LEVTY é uma empresa de serviços em transformação digital corporativa. Nossos especialistas possuem alto nível técnico, sendo boa parte desse conhecimento formado e consolidado no dia a dia do trabalho.

Somos um dos principais parceiros estratégicos da SYDLE e atuamos fortemente com a plataforma SYDLE ONE, uma das mais utilizadas por grandes empresas para gestão de processos.

Além disso, temos um ambiente propício para o crescimento profissional, contando com um clima descontraído e flexível.

Ficou claro que pessoas são a alma do nosso negócio, não é?! Somos uma empresa jovem, com uma equipe altamente escalável e que cresce de forma sustentável.

O que é preciso para entrar no nosso time?

  • Graduação concluída ou em andamento nos cursos de Ciência da Computação, Sistemas da Informação, Engenharias ou áreas afins;
  • Ter conhecimentos em metodologias ágeis;
  • Possuir experiência de até 2 anos no acompanhamento de ritos ágeis.

Além disso, pode ser um diferencial:

  • Possuir certificação PSM, KMP, PMI-ACP ou similares;
  • Ter experiência com desenvolvimento de software;
  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol.

O que você fará em seu dia a dia?

  • Ajudar o time a melhorar suas práticas e evoluir;
  • Ajudar o time na criação de incrementos de alto valor e a solucionar problemas que impeçam o bom andamento das entregas;
  • Garantir que os eventos sejam produtivos e positivos;
  • Assistir o time com comunicações internas e/ou externas, garantindo transparência e acessibilidade às informações;

Gostou da oportunidade? Entenda nossa seleção.

Ao cadastrar seu currículo, ele será analisado pelo nosso RH e, caso seja selecionado, entraremos em contato com você para informar sobre a nossa seleção - que ocorrerá em três etapas (Teste de Lógica, Bate-papo RH e Bate-papo Técnico). Portanto, verifique se seu contato no currículo está atualizado e confira sempre seu e-mail e telefone :)

Uma LEVTY para todos!

Entendemos que a inovação só nasce com a diversidade e sabemos da importância de cada um para a construção de um ambiente de trabalho autêntico e plural. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas, sem exceção, são abertas para todas as pessoas, e nossa seleção será adaptada de acordo com a necessidade de cada um!

Confira nossos benefícios!

Uma cesta de benefícios pensada para você!

title: Release & QA Analyst (Hybrid)
description:
Fastmarkets is an industry-leading price-reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, providing price data, news, analytics and events for the agriculture, forest products, metals and mining and new-generation energy markets.

Fastmarkets' data is critical for customers seeking to understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, enabling trading and risk management. Fastmarkets is a global business with a history dating back to 1865 and is built on trust and deep market knowledge. It has more than 600 employees spread across global locations in the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Finland and beyond.

Job Description

Our next generation of real-time market data platform operates around the globe, 24 x 7, connecting to 6+ financial exchanges, delivering real-time market data, benchmark prices, news content and research data to our customers around the world. This is an exciting and unique opportunity to join our team to help shape and build our financial data platform that will help power the business through the next phase of its digital growth.

The new platform is being engineered for the cloud as a set of scalable, fault-tolerant microservices with rich web and mobile UI’s. Our technology stack is largely Microsoft, although we also leverage a number of open source software adopting the right tool for the job approach.

As a Release Manager / QA Engineer reporting into the Digital Platforms Delivery Manager your time will be focused on planning, testing, tracking, release, deployment, communication, and risk management.

PRINCIPLE ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Hands on Release Management planning, co-ordination and implementation
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Release Testing
  • Maintaining Release Processes

KEY INTERFACES

  • Digital Platforms Delivery Manager
  • Product Owners / Product Management
  • Software engineering team
  • SRE

Qualifications

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly.

A successful candidate will have:

  • Hands on Release Management experience
  • Hands on QA experience
  • Solid understanding of Software Development Lifecycle
  • Good understanding of application infrastructure, system architecture, and operating systems
  • Ability to handle software infrastructure management & configuration management
  • Experience in coordinating cross-functional teams up to task completion
  • Release and testing automation experience using programming languages, tools, and frameworks; Cypress, Selenium, Playwright, Cucumber (Gherkin Syntax), TestNG, or a similar testing framework
  • 2-6 years of experience in the use of Jira for release management including Jira Releases, Jira Roadmaps, and Zephyr Test Type Jira Tickets (Zephyr plugin for Jira)
  • Knowledge of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
  • Experience in using at least one of the following Build & Deployment tools: GitHub Actions, Octopus, TeamCity, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, AWS etc.
  • Experience in using other day-to-day development tools such as GIT and various CLIs (Bash, cmd.exe, PowerShell), ability to use Kubernetes and Azure CLIs is a plus
  • Experience in working with DevOps and Agile methodologies.
  • A computer science degree or a similar discipline
  • 7-9 years of experience in working in an IT environment
  • General PC knowledge including Microsoft Office with expertise in Excel and a working knowledge of Access

A successful candidate will likely have some of the following:

  • Experience in at least one of the following programming languages: C#, Java, Python
  • Knowledge of traditional agile methodologies, including Scrum, Waterfall, or Kanban
  • Knowledge of market data, commodity exchanges and financial instruments

Personal Attributes

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent analytical skills
  • Structured thinking
  • Continuously looking for ways to improve (yourself, your team, the code the processes)
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to execute and deliver in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly collaborative and able to work across multiple teams and geographies
  • Results-driven, with a focus on long-term value creation

Additional Information

Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:

  • METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET . This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

You’ve read a little about us – now it’s over to you!

Project Environmental Permitting & Compliance Engineer / Scientist

Location: Warrington, PA, US, 18976-3653

Langan provides expert land development engineering and environmental consulting services for major developers, renewable energy producers, energy companies, corporations, healthcare systems, colleges/universities, and large infrastructure programs throughout the U.S. and around the world. Our employees collaborate seamlessly among 40+ offices and gain valuable hands-on experience that fosters career growth. Langan culture is entrepreneurial from advancing innovative technical solutions, to participating in robust training and knowledge sharing, to making progressive change within the communities we live and work.

Consistently ranked among the top ten “Best Firms to Work For” and Engineering News-Record’s top 50 firms worldwide, Langan attracts and retains the best talent in the industry. Employees thrive at Langan, a firm that fosters an inclusive and supportive work environment for all; prioritizes wellbeing, health, and safety; encourages volunteerism and philanthropy; offers workplace flexibility, along with carbon-neutral office spaces; and empowers individuals to contribute their skills and knowledge to make impactful contributions.

Job Summary

Langan is seeking an Environmental Permitting and Compliance Project Engineer, Scientist, or Manager to join its collaborative team in Doylestown, PA . This individual will serve a key function in performing multimedia environmental compliance and permitting projects, including air quality permitting and compliance, multi-media environmental compliance audits, development of monitoring and spill prevention and contingency plans, industrial wastewater and stormwater compliance, storage tank registration and compliance evaluations, waste management. Tasks will include preparing and overseeing technical reports, calculations and regulatory reports, permit applications, and on-site inspections and support. In this role, you will have the opportunity to partner cross-functionally with top industry leadership in a continuous learning environment.

Job Responsibilities

  • Prepare permit applications and compliance programs for multiple environmental media, including air, wastewater, stormwater, waste, spill prevention and storage tanks, EPCRA (Tier II, TRI);
  • Perform multi-media environmental compliance audits, gap assessments, inspections, and program reviews;
  • Develop and support implementation and management of various monitoring and spill prevention and contingency plans/programs (SPCC, FRP, SPR, SWPPP, Hazardous Waste Contingency Plans, TOMP, Slug Control, etc.);
  • Provide direct oversight and management of junior staff for specific project assignments;
  • Lead and/or assist in the preparation of proposals including development of scope and costs;
  • Manage project budgets and assist in invoicing as project or task manager;
  • Interact with and build relationships with clients, contractors/subcontractors, and internal practice leaders with a strong commitment to customer service and responsiveness to client needs;
  • Deliver on multiple projects and tasks within specific budgets, schedules, and deadlines;
  • Conduct field support at client sites including routine site inspections, collection of samples, and on-call support;
  • Train and mentor junior staff;
  • Perform other duties as requested.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental or Chemical Engineering, Environmental Science, or closely related field. Master’s degree preferred;
  • 6+ years of experience working with regulations and environmental permitting;
  • Professional certification preferred;
  • 40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER certification;
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple clients and projects;
  • Willingness and ability to maintain and develop existing client relationships as well as identify new opportunities is strongly desired;
  • Working knowledge of related software (Air Modeling Software, AERMOD, ProMax, a plus);
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical, multitasking, and judgment capabilities;
  • Ability to effectively work independently and in a team environment;
  • Possess reliable transportation for client meetings and job site visits and a valid driver’s license in good standing.

Langan provides a rich array of programs and benefits to help its employees advance their careers and enhance the quality of their lives. Our comprehensive compensation package includes: full-time employment company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage; life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, and paid pregnancy disability leave; 401(k)/Roth with company match; paid time off including parental and military leave; employee referral and professional license bonuses; and educational reimbursement.

Langan offers employee resource groups; flexible work schedules; extensive training; wellness programs; buddy and mentoring programs; and much more!

Langan is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We believe that an inclusive workplace is essential for the well-being and success of our employees.

  • Coletar amostras para exames laboratoriais;

  • Não deixar o plantão desassistido sem ter quem o possa substituir, mantendo a continuidade do cuidado do paciente;

  • Ministrar medicamentos por via oral e parenteral, exceto por gastrostomia;
  • Realizar controle hídrico;
  • Fazer curativos de lesões grau I e II;
  • Aspirações de vias aéreas superiores;
  • Aplicar oxigenoterapia, nebulização, enteroclisma, enema e calor ou frio;
  • Executar tarefas referentes à conservação e aplicação de vacinas;
  • Efetuar o controle de pacientes e de comunicantes em doenças transmissíveis;
  • Realizar testes e proceder à sua leitura, para subsídio de diagnóstico;
  • Colher material para exames laboratoriais;
  • Auxiliar em procedimentos invasivos e, se necessário, instrumentar;
  • Executar atividades de desinfecção e esterilização;
  • Prestar cuidados de higiene e conforto ao paciente e zelar por sua segurança, inclusive:
  • Alimentá-lo ou auxiliá-lo a alimentar-se por via oral;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e ordem do material, de equipamentos e de dependência de unidades de saúde;
  • Integrar a equipe de saúde;
  • Participar de atividades de educação em saúde, inclusive:
  • Orientar e treinar os pacientes e familiares nos cuidados com paciente pós alta, quanto ao cumprimento das prescrições de Enfermagem e médicas;
  • Auxiliar o Enfermeiro e o Técnico de Enfermagem na execução dos programas de educação para a saúde;
  • Executar os trabalhos de rotina vinculados à alta de pacientes;
  • Participar dos procedimentos pós-morte.

The Role
We are seeking a skilled Safety Service Technician to join our team, bringing expertise in inspecting, diagnosing, and maintaining essential safety systems. This role demands technical proficiency, adaptability, and a service-first approach, with opportunities to work internationally in diverse environments.
Key responsibilities for the Safety Service Technician role include but are not limited to:

  • Service and maintain clean agent systems (Novec, FM-200) and portable fire extinguishers (low and high pressure).
  • Inspect and maintain breathing equipment for air cylinders to ensure reliability.
  • Diagnose faults, troubleshoot issues, and execute repairs efficiently.
  • Test and calibrate pressure, flow, and level switches and transmitters.
  • Conduct maintenance in compliance with US and European fire safety system standards.
  • Liaise with supervisors to identify and address repair requirements.
  • Continuously improve processes and procedures to enhance service delivery and efficiency.
You will have the opportunity to develop in your role and feel proud of the work you do. Working at Survitec is fast paced but incredibly rewarding.
This is not just another job; this is your career.
About You
Essential criteria:
  • Bilingual: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Proven experience in inspecting and maintaining safety systems, including lifeboats, fire-fighting systems, breathing equipment, and fire extinguishers.
  • Technical and mechanical skills, with a focus on diagnosing and repairing faults.
  • Familiarity with US and European fire safety systems is essential.
  • Strong service-oriented mindset with a commitment to safety.
  • Willingness to adapt to varied working conditions and travel internationally.
  • Capable of working under pressure and independently.
  • Computer literacy for reporting and documentation.
  • Experience in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing safety systems.
  • Experienced in inspecting and testing pressure, flow, and level switches and transmitters.
  • Able to liaise effectively with supervisors and team members to ensure seamless operations.

Who are Survitec and what do we do?
Survitec are the world’s largest survival technology provider. For over 166 years, we have been protecting lives in the air, on land and at sea, through the design, manufacture, and servicing of Survival Technology.
Today, we are a global community of 3,000 professionals with presence in 96 countries partnering with our customers to provide innovative solutions that reduce risk and help keep you safe.
That's why the world's leading maritime, defence & government, energy and aerospace organisations trust us when it matters most and why we have been awarded the Gold Award by the Defence Employer Recognition Scheme

To Apply, please click the Apply button and submit your application via our website.
Please note, we do not accept direct applications via email nor do we accept speculative CVs from recruitment agencies.
Survitec is an equal opportunities employer. Our diverse global workforce protects lives, every single day. title: TECH ARTIST
description:
Big Moxi Games is expanding its technical art team to drive the development of external projects in collaboration with a major global publisher. We are looking for talented tech artists who bring a wealth of experience and a passion for crafting exceptional games.

Responsibilities:

Work with the art and engineering teams to implement in-game animations and systems.

Develop, maintain and document animation systems and pipelines.

Assist the team in planning animation work.

Required Skills:

Advanced Expertise in Unreal Engine Animation Systems:

Deep understanding and extensive hands-on experience with Unreal Engine’s animation systems, including Animation Blueprint Layers, Animation Multi-threading, and specific enhancements in Unreal Engine 5. The candidate should be proficient in creating complex animation systems that are both optimized and scalable.

Technical Animation Proficiency:

Proven practical experience in technical animation, with the ability to troubleshoot and solve sophisticated animation challenges. The ideal candidate will have experience integrating animations into diverse game environments and ensuring they interact seamlessly with other gameplay elements.

Comprehensive Knowledge of Unreal Engine Framework:

Mastery of the Unreal Engine framework, particularly in Blueprint visual scripting, to construct and maintain advanced animation pipelines. The candidate should demonstrate the ability to create efficient and maintainable Blueprint scripts that contribute to a cohesive and dynamic animation system.

Strong C++ and Unreal Engine Architecture:

A solid foundation in C++ programming, with an in-depth understanding of Unreal Engine’s animation-related class architecture. The candidate should be adept at extending Unreal Engine’s capabilities through C++ when needed, ensuring that all customizations enhance the overall animation system.

Expertise in Motion Matching:

Specialized knowledge in Motion Matching techniques, with practical experience implementing these within Unreal Engine. The candidate should understand the complexities of Motion Matching and be capable of integrating this technique to achieve realistic and responsive character movements in the game environment.

Proficiency with Inverse Kinematics (IK):

Strong experience with Inverse Kinematics systems within Unreal Engine, including both single-chain and full-body IK. The candidate should be skilled in setting up and fine-tuning IK for complex character rigs to ensure natural and accurate movement, particularly in dynamic gameplay scenarios. Understanding the intricacies of blending IK with other animation techniques to achieve fluid and responsive character actions is essential.

Nice to Have:

Experience with Unreal Engine 5.

Extensive knowledge of a wide range of games.

About the Company

Big Moxi Games is currently developing Wardens Rising, a blend of fast-paced isometric action and base defense for PC and console. We aim to build a strong portfolio of original IPs for mid-to-hard core gamers across the globe. Raising our artistry and craftsmanship with great attention to detail. At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth story while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

VENHA E CRESÇA JUNTO COM A GENTE!

Essa pessoa será responsável por pesquisar e conferir os documentos solicitados ou enviados para a empresa. Tratar a documentação, higienizar, organizar, realizar cadastro das caixas de entrada e saída conforme procedimentos estabelecidos pela empresa. RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Controlar a entrada e saída de pesquisas através das solicitações recebidas por emails dos clientes, sistema interno ou sistema do cliente;

  • Atualizar de planilhas com controles necessários, conforme determinado pelo cliente ou gestor, assim também com a inserção de dados no sistema interno ou do cliente em específico;
  • Atender aos clientes por telefone em suas solicitações de documentos e dar suporte sempre que solicitado em suas consultas via web;
  • Recepcionar e conferir os documentos físicos recebidos por malote dos clientes e dar baixa no sistema com a confirmação do recebimento;
  • Prestar Serviço externo nos clientes ou em outras Unidades da empresa, executando as tarefas de conferência, preparação, organização dos documentos para que sejam enviados para a guarda, sempre que necessário.

Fomos os primeiros da América Latina a desenvolver sistemas de gestão em cloud computing, considerando empresas públicas e privadas. Criamos ainda a primeira Inteligência Artificial para gestão pública, a Dara, que foi premiada duas vezes em 1° lugar como a melhor solução do Brasil para cidades inteligentes. Hoje, atuamos diariamente para transformar e descomplicar a gestão pública através do que há de melhor na tecnologia, com uma solução única e inteligente para gestão das cidades, seja na Contabilidade, na Saúde, na Educação, ou em mais de uma dezena de áreas.

Estamos crescendo Brasil afora, e sempre lançando novas soluções que estão transformando o futuro de pessoas e cidades. Nos últimos anos, conquistamos diversos prêmios e certificações da consultoria internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW). Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos como um dos 5 melhores times de RH do Brasil; em 2023, figuramos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar pela segunda vez no ranking Mulher e pela primeira vez no ranking LGBTI+; e em 2024, recebemos pela 5ª vez consecutiva a certificação de uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar. Além disso, em 2024, alcançamos o 1º lugar nacional no Prêmio Connected Smart Cities, sendo premiados pela melhor solução para cidades inteligentes no Brasil.
Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa. Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos tão motivados pelo nosso propósito e impacto quanto nós somos, que sejam apaixonados pela tecnologia, e que tenham muita garra para fazer acontecer. ️
Venha construir o futuro da gestão pública na IPM!

 Para essa posição, você vai precisar de:

Join to apply for the Logistics Quality Analyst role at Danfoss

Job Description
Danfoss is looking for an enthusiastic and innovative Logistics Quality Analyst. You will have the opportunity to be part of a thriving and motivated department where you can challenge yourself by managing a versatile and comprehensive position with a wide range of tasks and responsibilities.
The Logistics Quality Analyst will be responsible for supporting the governance of standard operating procedures (SOPs) in the logistics area, ensuring their update, review, and compliance with best practices and regulatory requirements. This professional will play a key role in process validation, compliance assurance, and the development of methodologies for control and continuous improvement.
Additionally, this role will oversee operational training management, ensuring that logistics teams are properly trained in the required processes and standards. The analyst will also be responsible for conducting internal and external audits, establishing corrective and preventive action plans to ensure operational excellence.
This position will report directed to the Regional Logistics Director for Latin America.
Job Responsibilities
 Responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to, the following.

  • SOP Governance: Oversee reviews, ensure the proper development and updating of logistics operational documents, and support teams in process standardization.
  • Training Management: Develop and maintain a structured training plan for operational teams, ensuring that the right people are trained in the necessary processes and procedures.
  • Audits & Compliance: Conduct internal process audits and support external audits, ensuring adherence to applicable standards and regulations (ISO 9000, AEO, etc.).
  • Process Validation: Work closely with logistics operational teams to validate and implement new processes and methodologies, ensuring efficiency and compliance.
  • Monitoring & Continuous Improvement: Identify process optimization opportunities, implement improvements, and create performance metrics to track the effectiveness of changes.
  • Control & Risk Management: Develop mechanisms to monitor and mitigate operational risks, ensuring compliance with regulations and internal policies.
  • Quality & Compliance Interface: Serve as the main point of contact for internal and external audits related to logistics operations.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Ensure proper organization and traceability of documents, audit evidence, and training records, providing periodic reports to internal stakeholders.
Background & Skills
 At Danfoss, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a broader perspective in decision-making. When you consider this job posting, do you feel like your profile is not a perfect match? Numerous studies have found that women and people of color are more likely to apply only when they meet all requirements listed in the job posting. Even if you do not check all the boxes, we encourage you to apply anyway. We are curious to find out how you can bring new insights to the role or to Danfoss as an organization.
The ideal candidate possesses these skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Quality Management, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in quality management, audits, and operational process standardization.
  • Knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9000, Lean, Six Sigma, SOX, or similar).
  • Experience in internal and external audits, action plan development, and non-compliance monitoring.
  • Ability to structure and conduct training programs for operational teams.
  • Experience with documentation and process governance in logistics operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and influence different stakeholders.
  • Upper-Intermediate English and Intermediate Spanish.
  • Green Belt certification in Lean Six Sigma.
  • Experience with quality management tools (e.g., PDCA, FMEA, 5S, Kaizen, etc.).
Danfoss – Engineering Tomorrow
 At Danfoss, we are engineering solutions that allow the world to use resources in smarter ways - driving the sustainable transformation of tomorrow. No transformation has ever been started without a group of passionate, dedicated and empowered people. We believe that innovation and great results are driven by the right mix of people with diverse backgrounds, personalities, skills, and perspectives, reflecting the world in which we do business. To make sure the mix of people works, we strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are treated equally, respected, and valued for who they are. It is a strong priority within Danfoss to improve the health, working environment and safety of our employees.
Following our founder’s mindset “action speaks louder than words”, we set ourselves ambitious targets to protect the environment by embarking on a plan to become CO2 neutral latest by 2030.

Vaga presencial para a cidade de Monte Belo-MG

Requisitos mínimos

Missão do Cargo:

Aprender e aplicar os princípios do Scrum, que é uma metodologia ágil para gestão e desenvolvimento de projetos. Como trainee, a pessoa está em fase de aprendizado e pode desempenhar várias funções sob supervisão, com o objetivo de se familiarizar com o processo e adquirir habilidades práticas.

Apoiar o Scrum Master:

Auxiliar na facilitação das cerimônias do Scrum, como as reuniões diárias (daily stand-ups), planejamento de sprint, revisões de sprint e retrospectivas.

Aprender a remover impedimentos que a equipe possa enfrentar.

Participar das Cerimônias Scrum:

Participar ativamente de todas as reuniões do Scrum para entender como cada cerimônia contribui para o sucesso do sprint.

Observar e aprender a dinâmica da equipe durante essas reuniões.

Colaborar com a Equipe de Desenvolvimento:

Trabalhar de perto com os desenvolvedores para entender os desafios técnicos e as tarefas diárias.

Ajudar na estimativa de histórias e tarefas, aprendendo a avaliar o esforço necessário para completar o trabalho.

Aprender sobre o Backlog do Produto:

Ajudar o Product Owner a gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto.

Entender como as histórias do usuário são escritas e como elas são organizadas e priorizadas.

Documentação e Relatórios:

Manter registros precisos das atividades e do progresso do sprint.

Aprender a usar ferramentas de gestão de projetos Azure.

Feedback e Melhoria Contínua:

Participar de sessões de feedback e retrospectivas para identificar áreas de melhoria.

Aprender a implementar mudanças baseadas no feedback recebido para melhorar continuamente o processo Scrum.

Estudo e Formação Contínua:

Dedicar tempo ao estudo das práticas ágeis e do Scrum, incluindo leitura de livros, participação em cursos e workshops.

Suporte Administrativo:

Executar tarefas administrativas que ajudem na organização e na execução do Scrum, como atualização de quadros de tarefas e preparação de documentos para reuniões.

title: CRA II
description:
Join to apply for the CRA II role at Fortrea

Join to apply for the CRA II role at Fortrea

As a leading global contract research organization (CRO) with a passion for scientific rigor and decades of clinical development experience, Fortrea provides pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device customers a wide range of clinical development, patient access, and technology solutions across more than 20 therapeutic areas. Conducting operations in ~100 countries, Fortrea is transforming drug and device development for partners and patients across the globe.
Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Site management responsibility for clinical studies according to Fortrea’s Standard Operating Procedures, ICH GCP Guidelines, applicable project plans and Sponsor requirements, including verification of study training records.
  • Conducts site monitoring responsibilities for clinical trials according to Fortrea’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ICH guidelines and GCP; including Pre-study, Site Initiation, Process Monitoring, Routine Monitoring, and Close-out Visits.
  • Prepares and implements project plans related to Clinical Monitoring responsibilities.
  • Ensures the protection of subjects by verifying that informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to alongside applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Safeguards data integrity by careful source document review, source document verification, query generation, and resolution against established data review guidelines on Fortrea or client data management systems.
  • Confirms Site Regulatory documents and applicable eTMF/Sponsor Documents are complete and current throughout the duration of the trial.
  • Guarantees that the study Investigational Product inventory and accountability is accurate and that study materials are stored securely and per protocol requirements.
  • Ensures adherence to global quality control and CRA performance metrics.
  • Ensures audit readiness at site level.
  • Acts in the project role of a Lead CRA as assigned.
  • General On-Site Monitoring Responsibilities:
  • Ensure the study staff who will conduct the protocol have received the proper materials and instructions to safely enter subjects/patients into the study. Ensure the protection of study subjects or patients by performing eligibility review, verifying that screening, informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to according to the applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure the integrity of the source data reported by careful source document review. Monitor data for missing or implausible data.
  • Ensure study data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance; identify deficiencies, deviations and discrepancies, and initiate corrective action as required.
  • Ensure the resources of the Sponsor and Fortrea are spent wisely by performing the required monitoring tasks in an efficient manner, according to SOPs and established guidelines, including managing travel expenses in an economical fashion according to Fortrea travel policy.
  • Travel, including air travel, may be required and is an essential function of the job.
  • Prepare and submit accurate and timely trip reports.
  • Independently perform eCRF review, 100% source data verification, query generation and resolution against established data review guideline with or without direct supervision, on Fortrea or client data management systems, as assigned by management.
  • Assist with the administration of clinical research projects, recruiting investigators (if applicable), collecting investigator documentation and site management.
  • Update, navigate, and maintain Fortrea or study/Sponsor-specific trial management tools/eClinical systems.
  • Track IP shipments and supplies, as needed.
  • Track and follow-up on serious adverse events as assigned.
  • Work closely with the study team, align monitoring to critical study timelines ensuring study deliverables are met.
  • Prepare and implement study-specific monitoring plans and site Initiation slides, as assigned.
  • Attend investigators’ meetings (if applicable), project team meetings and teleconferences, and others as needed.
  • Present training content for site initiation.
  • Assist with training of new employees (e.g., co-monitoring).
  • All other duties as needed or assigned.
Qualifications (Minimum Required)
  • University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g., nursing licensure). An equivalent amount of experience can be substituted as appropriate.
  • Thorough understanding of ICH GCP Guidelines and understanding of local regulatory requirements.
  • Thorough knowledge of monitoring procedures.
  • Basic understanding of the clinical trial process.
  • Fluent in local office language and in English, both written and verbal.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.
Experience (Minimum Required)
  • External Candidates:
  • University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g., nursing licensure). AND
  • A minimum of 2 years of Clinical Monitoring experience.
  • Internal Candidates:
  • Internal candidates with a minimum of 2 years of Clinical Monitoring experience.
  • Ability to monitor study sites independently according to monitoring plan, project requirements, SOPs, and ICH GCP guidelines.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Have an understanding of the Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reporting, process production of reports, narratives and follow up of SAEs.
  • Good planning, organization, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Works efficiently and effectively in a matrix environment.
Preferred Qualifications Include
  • Thorough working knowledge of Fortrea SOPs for site monitoring.
  • One (1) or more additional years of experience in a related field (i.e., medical, clinical, pharmaceutical, laboratory, research, data analysis, data management or technical writing) is preferred.
  • Phase I monitoring experience.
  • Life Science or Nursing qualification.
  • Specific skills, systems, certifications, and/or licenses preferred.
  • Personal characteristics (leadership, problem solving, interpersonal skills).
  • Good attention to detail.
  • Methodical approach to work.
  • Good understanding of medical and clinical research terminology and clinical research processes.
  • An understanding of the basics of physiology, pharmacology, and medical devices (when applicable).
  • Good understanding of the principles of ICH GCP, ISO 14155 (if applicable) and local regulatory requirements.
  • Good computer literacy with working knowledge of PCs, Windows and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Good oral and written internal and external communication. Strong interpersonal team and organizational skills, personal presentation. The ability to communicate effectively in English.
  • Focus on Customer.
  • Innovate and Change.
  • Pursue Scientific and Process Excellence.
  • Work with Others.
  • Achieve Results.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of data and information during interactions with staff at all levels and across studies and sponsors.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct clinical operations activities most effectively and efficiently.
  • Good analytical and negotiation skills.
  • Experience using e-clinical systems (e.g., clinical trial management system (CTMS)).
  • For medical device positions, experience in providing customer service to device end users.
Physical Demands/Work Environment
  • Must be able to sit at a computer for long periods of time.
  • Must be able to use hands to finger, handle or touch objects, tools or controls, including a computer keyboard, for up to 8 hours per day.
  • Standard office and/or home working environment.
  • Clinical Research Unit and hospital environment (administrative only).
  • Risk of eye strain.
  • Will involve outside of normal office hours as required by the role.
  • Travel Requirement is 60% of the time (traveling to study sites).

Our unwavering commitment is to revolutionize the development process, ensuring the swift delivery of life-changing ideas and therapies to patients in need. Company Overview
ABEC is a leading supplier to the biopharmaceutical manufacturing industry. ABEC's unique value is based on combining long experience with the ability to engineer, design, manufacture, commission, qualify, and service the entire bioprocess to reduce overall cost, shorten time to market, and maximize productivity. ABEC's products include process and equipment engineering/consulting services, comprehensive site services, bioreactors and fermenters, filtration and chromatography systems, prep and hold systems, and cleaning/sterilization systems.
Role Overview
ABEC’s Headquarters in Bethlehem, PA serves a global market. To support our growth, ABEC is seeking a Regional Sales Manager who will be responsible for top-line sales growth in our Stainless Steel and Integrated Solutions Business Unit. The Regional Manager will be ABEC’s primary customer interface in the region for that Business Unit, and will lead the sales of custom projects based on ABEC’s large scale biopharma manufacturing capabilities. As such, the Regional Manager has the communication and analytical skills needed to sell total solutions in addition to individual equipment sets.
The ideal candidate will reside in the Midwest USA or Research Triangle NC areas.
 Specific Responsibilities
The individual will be responsible for selling upstream and downstream process solutions to the Biopharmaceutical Industry. As such, the Regional Sales Manager has the communication and analytical skills needed to sell total solutions in addition to individual equipment sets.

  • Develop and execute sales plans to achieve revenue targets and market share growth in the territory through the sales of total solutions incorporating ABEC products such as bioreactors, fermenters, mixing systems, downstream equipment systems, and new products.
  • Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities with biologic producers (biologics, vaccines, CMOs, cell and gene companies, etc.).
  • Maintain and deepen relationships with existing clients, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and repeat business coupled with a strong drive to find and grow new customers.
  • Identify, prospect, and secure new business to support revenue growth in Eastern USA.
  • Develop and implement sales strategies for new account prospects, focusing primarily on existing customers, prospects and new business opportunities.
  • Work with ABEC Business Development team to plan, conduct, and follow up on sales calls. Maintain a close working relationship with the Bethlehem, Pennsylvania office to drive activity/results through the leveraging and consistent application of corporate best practice sales processes and initiatives.
  • Closely co-ordinate with colleagues across the organization to ensure alignment on specific account strategies.
  • Identifies prospects and develops sales strategies to secure new business. This includes sales calls, competitive analysis, coordination of presentations and proposals, and all follow-up activity coordinated within that plan/approach.
  • Represent ABEC at industry events, conferences, and trade shows to promote the brand, generate leads, and showcase ABEC solutions.
  • Providing regular reporting of activities including forecasts and call reports.
  • Providing input and analysis of market and industry trends.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Ability to travel when required.
  • Will play an active role in identifying and driving Continuous Improvement (CI) opportunity.
Qualifications
  • The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Engineering, plus a proven record of successful consultative sales experience, including strategic selling and negotiation. Successful related work experience in a services industry may be considered.
  • Minimum of 5 years outside direct sales success using consultative and solution oriented sales approaches.
  • Knowledge in one or all of the following industries: Engineering, manufacturing, biopharmaceuticals.
  • Ability to call on and influence the decision makers in an organization for the areas represented (operations, quality, business unit, product development, procurement, engineering, etc.).
  • Demonstrated success working in fast-paced, highly competitive, deadline oriented environment.
  • Self-motivated individual who exhibits sense of urgency and professionalism in all sales and service related activity.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, follow-up, negotiation, and closing skills. Strong emphasis on the ability to listen and present appropriate solutions.
  • Travel is required for this position-estimated at 60% to 80%.
  • Fluent English speaking.
  • Awareness of and prior experience with implementing Continuous Improvement (CI) a plus.
  • Prior Lean/Six Sigma experience a plus.

title: Com foco em segurança e eficiência, IPEL realiza primeira Kaizen Week
description:
Com foco na construção de processos sustentáveis e no fortalecimento da cultura de melhoria contínua, a IPEL realizou, em fevereiro, sua primeira Kaizen Week – um período de 10 dias totalmente dedicado à análise e aprimoramento de processos, com base na metodologia japonesa Kaizen. A iniciativa, liderada pela área de segurança do trabalho, teve como objetivo promover melhorias de forma sistêmica e integrada, com envolvimento direto dos operadores de linha e lideranças.

“A motivação para implantar a Kaizen Week foi a necessidade de estruturar um modelo mais amplo de melhoria, que não olhasse apenas para pontos isolados, mas para a unidade como um todo. Essa metodologia nos ajuda a construir ações sustentáveis, com foco na eficiência e na segurança operacional”, explicou Breno Gomes Feitosa, gerente de Segurança e Saúde da IPEL.

A área escolhida para o primeiro ciclo foi um setor onde foram registrados os incidentes mais graves da companhia nos últimos cinco anos. A escolha foi baseada em uma análise de criticidade e riscos, conforme a matriz S de segurança. O planejamento seguiu as etapas do ciclo PDCA – planejar, fazer, verificar e agir – e incluiu oito horas de treinamento para capacitação das equipes envolvidas.

Foto: IPEL

Durante a Kaizen Week, 22 instruções de trabalho foram revisadas, eliminando riscos e padronizando procedimentos. Entre as ações práticas implementadas estão, por exemplo, a substituição de estiletes convencionais por modelos retráteis com trava de segurança, a aquisição de uma retífica para cortes de tubetes e papéis e a instalação de 15 novas sinalizações de segurança. Também foram criadas cinco ações de melhoria contínua (Kaizens), como reorganização de áreas de armazenamento, suporte para posicionamento de equipamentos e melhoria na sinalização dos corrimãos.

O projeto teve adesão significativa da equipe: dos 21 operadores da linha, 15 participaram diretamente das atividades. “Mesmo com as limitações de turno, conseguimos grande envolvimento da linha de frente, o que mostra o valor da ação. O engajamento dos colaboradores é um dos maiores resultados”, avaliou Breno.

Algumas melhorias seguem em fase de implementação, como a aquisição de um carro para troca de bobinas e o redesenho do estoque de pallets, com previsão de entrega ainda em maio. A expectativa é que a experiência positiva se desdobre em uma prática recorrente. “Atualizamos toda a equipe de segurança e nosso objetivo é realizar uma Kaizen Week por mês, a partir do segundo semestre, cada uma focada em uma nova frente de trabalho”, antecipou o gerente.

SOBRE A IPEL

Fundada há 40 anos em Indaial, Santa Catarina, a IPEL é uma das maiores companhias brasileiras do setor de tissue. Sua produção de papel higiênico, papel toalha e guardanapos chega a mais de 7 mil toneladas ao mês, com distribuição em mais de 3 mil clientes de varejo, com a linha doméstica, e atacado, com a linha professional . A empresa conta com cerca de 800 profissionais diretos e possui um portfólio de marcas próprias (Nobby, Ness, Qualité, Natureza, Top One, Adorable, Mollis, Mondeo e Superpel), além de produção private label .

  • Provide daily instruction and select learning activities appropriate to student's needs based on the music curriculum set by the Allentown Diocese.

  • Actively establishes and maintains appropriate student supervision so that students have a safe, orderly, effective, and productive environment established from Notre Dame of Bethlehem School's discipline procedures.
  • Actively supervises students in hallways before, after, and between classes, in a library, in the cafeteria, in bus areas, and at special events, ensuring safety and security.
  • Knowledge of emergency evacuation routes, school procedures, and regulations for the classrooms assigned.
  • Attend school preparation days, in-service and staff development opportunities, and Diocesan educational workshops; attend and participate in school faculty meetings, open houses, and other school-related activities upon the request of the principal.
  • Maintains appropriate confidentiality regarding school/workplace matters including social media and online platforms. Follow all Notre Dame of Bethlehem School and Allentown Diocese policies as per the teacher's handbook.
  • Any other duties as assigned by the Principal.
Additional Condition Of Employment
Due to the nature and mission of the Catholic Church, all employees are bound to exhibit respect for the teachings and discipline of the Church regarding matters of faith and morals, including maintaining a lifestyle that is in conformity with the teachings of the Catholic Church.
Educational Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Music or Music Education preferred.
  • PA Teacher certification preferred.

  • Must communicate effectively with parents, students, and co-workers in a positive and enthusiastic manner.
  • Possess an understanding of child development and the skills necessary to relate to the students being taught.
  • Possess an understanding of the supervision of employees and the communication skills necessary to relate to adult employees and volunteers in a collegial, as well as effective, and efficient manner.
  • Ability to handle classroom situations with fairness and patience.
  • Able to maintain a high level of energy. Ability to respond calmly to overwhelming and difficult situations.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality, a high degree of credibility, integrity, and self-confidence is essential.
PRIOR TO INTERVIEW: Clear records of Pennsylvania State Police Criminal Record Check (PATCH), Pennsylvania Child Abuse History, and Federal Bureau of Investigation Criminal Background Fingerprint Check as required under Commonwealth of Pennsylvania's Act 153 of 2014 (at least 1 year old.) As well as attendance at a Protecting God's Children class and Mandated Reporter Training.

description:
Unila seleciona professores formadores para curso de graduação

A Universidade Federal da Integração Latino-Americana (Unila) está recebendo inscrições para processo seletivo de professores formadores para curso de Licenciatura Intercultural Indígena (no território Yvy Mbyte).

São 6 vagas mais formação de cadastro reserva destinadas, preferencialmente, a servidores da UNILA (professores e técnico-administrativos) ou de secretarias de educação.

Requisitos:

  • Pertencer, preferencialmente, ao quadro da UNILA como docente ou Técnico-Administrativo em Educação (TAE) ou de secretarias de educação;
  • Ter formação em nível de pós-graduação stricto sensu;
  • Possuir formação, em nível de graduação ou pós-graduação, na área da disciplina que irá ministrar;
  • Comprovar experiência de no mínimo 1 (um) ano no magistério;
  • Possuir experiência na formação de professores, comprovada por pelo menos 1 (um) dos seguintes critérios: a) docência em disciplina de curso de licenciatura; b) docência em curso de formação continuada para professores(as) da educação básica; c) atuação como formador(a), tutor(a) ou coordenador(a) em programas ou projetos institucionais de formação de professores(as) da educação básica; d) coordenação de curso de licenciatura; e) docência ou gestão pedagógica na educação básica.

O curso de Licenciatura Intercultural Indígena na qual os professores formadores atuarão tem carga horária total de 3.210 horas/aula, com organização em regime semestral e duração prevista de quatro anos.

O curso tem como público-alvo o Povo Guarani que vive na região do Yvy Mbyte (centro do território Guarani), abrangendo o Oeste do Paraná (municípios de Guaíra, Terra Roxa, Santa Helena, Itaipulândia, São Miguel do Iguaçu e Diamante D'Oeste); leste do Paraguai (Departamento do Alto Paraná e Canindeyú); nordeste Argentino (província de Misiones).

Todas as atribuições dos professores formadores estão listadas no item 3.11 do edital.

Como se inscrever no processo seletivo de professores formadores

As inscrições para o processo seletivo de professores formadores podem ser realizadas até o dia 19/09 por meio do preenchimento do formulário disponível em inscreva.unila.edu.br .

Seleção

O Processo Seletivo de professores formadores acontecerá em uma única etapa, classificatória, de análise dos documentos apresentados no ato de inscrição.

Mais informações no Edital 123/2024 – Processo de seleção de professores formadores.

title: Business Development Ops.
description:
>>Sobrenós

Muitos acham que sonhamos grande demais, mas aqui na XP Inc. acreditamos no impossível. Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram autonomia e liberdade, e abraçaram nossos desafios.

Acreditamos que temos tudo para ser a maior instituição financeira da América Latina, tornando o Brasil referência em inovação e educando financeiramente mais de 50 milhões de brasileiros. É isso que nos move em direção ao nosso propósito de melhorar a vida das pessoas.

>> Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: colocamos os interesses do cliente como prioridade.
  • Sonho grande: miramos no impossível, construímos juntos os caminhos e chegamos lá.
  • Mente aberta: estamos abertos para inovar, sempre baseados em fatos e dados, sem medo de errar e dispostos a corrigir.
  • Espírito empreendedor: assumimos protagonismo na tomada de decisão e focamos nosso tempo na geração de valor a longo prazo.

Se identificou com a nossa cultura? Então embarque nesse foguete!

>> Sobre a vaga

Essa oportunidade tem como objetivo fazer relacionamento direto com líderes e gestores (majoritariamente, mas não exclusivo) dos escritórios de assessoria (B2B) sobre temas do universo operacional (processos e produtos). O principal desafio está na resolutividade e destraves de problemas operacionais do escritório que precisem de escalation interno na XP, por geralmente ter direta conexão com indicadores financeiros (captação e receita). Também faz parte do escopo a potencialização e construção de inteligência operacional no escritório (construção de áreas dedicadas). A função também passa por esferas de suporte comercial (rankings e selos do canal além de agendas com o time do Academy) e temas estratégicos como preditivo churn de clientes e assessores.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Resolutividade de problemas operacionais travados ou mal iniciados entre escritório e XP;
  • Desenvolvimento e potencialização de times operacionais dentro do escritório;
  • Análises e diagnósticos de problemas acerca de churn da operação;
  • Potencialização de frentes de performance indireta (convites academy b2b, selos, rankings do canal).

>> Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir CPA-20 ou PQO.

>> Benefícios para você:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.
  • Sociedade: aqui você terá a cultura, ambiente e ferramentas que precisa para ter condições de ser dono da sua própria jornada e quem sabe até de um pedaço da empresa.

Localidade : São Paulo.

Modelo de atuação: Híbrido (presencial necessário 4x na semana).

>> Diversidade na XP Inc.

Nosso propósito é melhorar a vida das pessoas. Acreditamos que para isso, a diversidade do nosso país deve ser refletida em nosso ambiente de trabalho, e que só assim conseguiremos desenvolver as melhores soluções para diferentes necessidades e pessoas. Buscamos, todos os dias, a responsabilidade de quebrar vieses dentro e fora da XP Inc. por meio de nossas equipes e compromissos com a nossa sociedade.

A General Mills está comprometida em ser uma força do bem por meio de uma estratégia global de inclusão para levar diversidade às nossas pessoas e cultura, possibilitando maiores níveis de envolvimento com nossos colaboradores para crescermos junto com nossos clientes e consumidores.
Para nós, criar um ambiente inclusivo e fomentar a diversidade impulsiona o crescimento da companhia, além de dar suporte para o crescimento de nossos colaboradores.

Sobre a posição:

  • Padronizar e melhorar processos produtivos para maximizar os resultados aumentando produtividade e reduzindo perdas, participa e apoia a inovação de produtos na manufatura em escala industrial.

Responsabilidades:

Padronização de processos:

  • Elaborar e revisar lista de materiais (Bill of Materials)
  • Definir padrões de produção: velocidade de linha, número de pessoas, roteiros de produção
  • Definir e elaborar padrões de ajustes de equipamentos (center line) e instruções de trabalho.
  • Capacitar tecnicamente os times operacionais quanto a operação e ajustes nos equipamentos e processos.
  • Elaborar e definir as perdas dos processos e o balanço de massa.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho seguro e colaborativo, aderindo às regulamentações de segurança e saúde.

Inovação:

  • Apoiar as áreas de inovação liderando os testes industriais na manufatura para lançamento de novos produtos, embalagens e matérias primas
  • Definir e alterar os padrões da produção de acordo com as inovações e resultados dos testes industriais.

Aumento de produtividade:

  • Liderar projetos de melhoria que envolvam CAPEX;
  • Participar ativamente das análises de causa raiz e propor soluções técnicas para as perdas;
  • Dimensionar a capacidade de produção das linhas atuais e futura;
  • Participar ativamente da mudança de cultura em busca de melhoria contínua através das ferramentas do modelo
  • de gestão Zero Loss.
  • Governar e executar projetos que gerem economia financeira para a companhia, com foco em redução de perdas
  • (Performance e Perdas Base Zero);
  • Liderar, orientar e capacitar as pessoas em Projetos de Melhoria - DMAIC, SMED, Kaizens;

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo (Engenharias: Produção, Alimentos ou afins);
  • Conhecimento e domínio de Pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento em Cultura de Perda Zero;
  • Conhecimento em Lean Manufacturing (Produção Enxuta), IWS – Sistemas de Trabalho Integrado, TPM -
  • Manutenção Produtiva Total, ou WCM – Manufatura Classe Mundial;
  • Ciclo PDCA para análise de causa raiz (Definição de planos de ação – 5W2H, Diagrama de processos; Diagrama de
  • Ishikawa e 5 Porquês);
  • Minímo formado na metodologia DMAIC - Green Belt. Desejável formado na metodologia DMAIC Black Belt;

  • Conhecimento SAP
  • Ferramentas estatísticas - Minitab

  • Gerenciar Projetos;

  • Flexibilidade, resiliência e agilidade na tomada de decisões.

Descrição da Empresa

A General Mills é uma empresa líder global em alimentos e trabalha para fazer os alimentos que o mundo ama! Nossas marcas globais incluem Cheerios, Annie's, Yoplait, Nature Valley, Häagen-Dazs, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Old El Paso, Wanchai Ferry, Yoki, Blue e muitas outras. Com sede em Minneapolis, Minnesota, EUA, a companhia chegou ao Brasil em 1997, quando iniciou as vendas do sorvete premium Häagen-Dazs. Em 2012, adquiriu o Grupo Yoki Alimentos, conquistando um novo modelo de negócios e tornando-se proprietária das marcas Yoki, Kitano e Mais Vita, reconhecidas pelos brasileiros há décadas. description:
