6 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Nuclear Pharmacist role at Cardinal Health

What Nuclear Pharmacy Contributes To Cardinal Health
Pharmacy Operations is responsible for the safe, efficient and effective coordination of Cardinal Health's pharmacy operations that service acute care hospitals, hospital retail customers, ambulatory care and alternate site facilities, oncology and cardiology practices as well as retail customers.
Nuclear Pharmacy is responsible for providing radiopharmaceuticals and other drugs to medical care providers under highly regulated State and Federal guidelines; may also consult with or advise physicians and nuclear medicine technologists on the safe and efficacious use of radioactive drugs for diagnosis and therapy. Licensed.
Job Summary
PHARMACY ONLY
Through effective leadership and coordination with a team of direct reports, the primary purpose of the Pharmacist II, Nuclear is to manage, facilitate, and oversee execution of day-to-day operations of the nuclear pharmacy. The Pharmacist II, Nuclear has completed all necessary training and is licensed to be a practicing nuclear pharmacist in their state of occupation. As such, this job has responsibility for optimizing pharmacy operations and procedures to ensure consistent and efficient delivery to control costs, minimize waste, maximize customer satisfaction and deliver positive patient outcomes while maintaining compliance with Federal and state regulatory agencies. In addition, this job has responsibility for managing inventory, processing orders, compounding patient-specific doses of drugs and directing a team of drivers to deliver medications after they have been tested for quality.
Schedule

  • 40 hours
  • Rotating night shift every 3rd to 4th week. Typically 1:30 am and 9:30 am.
  • Day shift is typically is 7:30 am to 3:30 pm.
  • Will work weekend and on call rotation every 3rd to 4th week.
  • Will work holiday rotation as assigned
  • Candidate must be flexible to work different days, schedules, hours, come in early, stay late, or work overtime based on business needs.
Accountabilities
  • Provides pharmaceutical care to patients as a staff pharmacist, including compounding of nuclear medications, testing for quality through chromatography, and directing distribution of medication using a team of drivers.
  • Assesses and maintains pharmacy inventory and executes necessary orders, including reviews, to maintain optimal supply and ongoing availability of drugs, identifying and procuring alternative drugs to mitigate risks, when necessary.
  • Manages and directs internal workflows of nuclear pharmacy, including optimization of staffing and scheduling to maintain best-in-class and streamlined pharmacy operations.
  • Assists in execution of plans for lowering costs, increasing efficiency and driving profitable growth to support strategic business objectives in the nuclear pharmacy business.
  • Maintains relationships with outside suppliers and vendors to understand availability of drug components and assist in demand planning.
  • Participates in administrative tasks to facilitate nuclear pharmacy operations, including interactions with customers.
  • May oversee running of the facility (known as Pharmacist in Charge) if needed
  • Performs other job-related duties as required to ensure the goals and objectives of the department are met including delivering doses if necessary.
  • May assist with pharmacist duties in other states to provide staffing coverage in neighboring pharmacies
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy or PharmD
  • Valid Pharmacist’s license in the state in which the pharmacy operates, or is in the process of obtaining a valid license
  • Ability to get pharmacist license in other states for central fill needs and staffing purposes
  • Must complete at least 200 hours of academic training in a nuclear pharmacy through an accredited program
  • Working knowledge of biohazardous waste management procedures
  • Ability to hear, write, and speak clearly in order to communicate with customers and health care professionals
  • Strong customer service skills
  • Manual dexterity required for occasional reach, lifting and holding of small objects
  • Demonstrated manual dexterity in order to dispense doses
  • Manage weight up to 65 pounds
  • Willingness to travel if needed
  • Must hold a valid driver's license in the state in which the pharmacy is located or obtain one upon hire
  • Comfortable driving in all types of weather conditions (rain, sleet, snow, fog, wind and sun)
  • Deliveries occur during both nighttime and daytime conditions
  • Flexibility to work various shifts or overtime as needed
  • Intermediate computer skills (ability to use computers and tablets)
  • Ability to work weekends or be in a weekend rotation
  • Ability to work on call or be in an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work holidays or be in a holiday rotation
  • Prior Authorized User certification is preferred. Nuclear Pharmacy Training can be provided
What is expected of you and others at this level
  • Applies working knowledge in the application of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to perform varied tasks
  • Works on projects of moderate scope and complexity
  • Identifies possible solutions to a variety of technical problems and takes actions to resolve
  • Applies judgment within defined parameters
  • Receives general guidance may receive more detailed instruction on new projects
  • Work reviewed for sound reasoning and accuracy

Bonus eligible: No

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage

The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.
Candidates who are back-to-work, people with disabilities, without a college degree, and Veterans are encouraged to apply.

description:
Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.
Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM CC que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha uma atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.
Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Participar e dar continuidade às atividades determinadas pela Gerência, Coordenação e Supervisão de Enfermagem;
  • Exercer a função assistencial, educativa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem;Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e os que dificultam o processo de enfermagem;
  • Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor buscando o bem-estar da equipe interdisciplinar;
  • Solucionar as intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente;
  • Prestar assistência aos pacientes, atendendo suas necessidades básicas (higiene e conforto, apoio emocional), zelando pela sua segurança;
  • Participar de reuniões com a Gerência, Coordenação e/ou Supervisão de Enfermagem quando solicitado;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão dentro da sala operatória, checando organização da mesma, conferindo materiais, incluindo equipamentos necessários ao ato anestésico-cirúrgico e materiais que necessitam de data em dia;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da Comissão de Controle de Infecções Hospitalares (CCIH), de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP);
  • Ser assíduo, pontual e disciplinado;
  • Manter sua chefia direta informadas sobre intercorrências do serviço, solicitando da mesma, quando necessário, as devidas providências;
  • Responsabilizar-se por toda aparelhagem de sua sala operatória, zelando pelo seu uso adequadamente;
  • Comunicar ao enfermeiro supervisor qualquer defeito ou anormalidades ocorridas com materiais e equipamentos em sala;
  • Avaliar a necessidade de material permanente (Braçadeira de Pressão não invasiva - PNI, cabo de oxímetro e etc) e comunicar a sua chefia direta, para que seja providenciada a sua reposição;
  • Avaliar a necessidade de material descartável de consumo (Campos de cobertura cirurgica (LPS), campos de mesa auxiliar e etc) providenciando a sua reposição;
  • Realizar reposição dos impressos da sala cirúrgica
  • Usar adequadamente os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs), de acordo com ambiente e/ou tipo de trabalho realizado e a Norma Regulamentadora 32 (NR32);
  • Preencher no primeiro horário do plantão o check list da sala de cirurgia ? repondo os materiais faltantes;
  • Estar ciente das cirurgias marcadas para a sala sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Prover materiais e equipamentos adequados para sala cirúrgica, de acordo com cada tipo de cirurgia e com as necessidades individuais do paciente de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) de preparo de sala operatória;
  • Observar as condições de limpeza da sala cirúrgica no início do dia e se a mesma não estiver em condições satisfatórias, solicitar a equipe de higienização do plantão;
  • Checar o funcionamento da régua de gases, aparelhos de anestesia, monitores multi parâmetros, iluminação da sala e focos. Qualquer defeito apresentado comunicar ao enfermeiro supervisor do plantão;
  • Solicitar o paciente ao maqueiro, quando delegado pelo enfermeiro;
  • Assegurar as conformidades quanto às metas planejadas pelo Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente (NSP);
  • Identificar as não conformidades e comunicar o enfermeiro para realizar a Notificação do NSP;
  • Realizar admissão do paciente no centro cirúrgico, quando delegado pelo enfermeiro, dando continuidade ao preenchimento de Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem Perioperatória (SAEP);
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética da enfermagem.
Esperamos que você tenha:
  • Nível Médio e técnico de enfermagem concluído;
  • Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência na função, em centro cirúrgico;
  • Tipos de cirurgias, cuidados com pré, trans e pós operatório;
  • Coren ativo.

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Refeição no Local;
  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Clube de benefícios

title: XP Future | Campo Grande
description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros).
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e Impacto:

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.

*Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc.

Etapas do Processo:

  1. Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

  2. Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

  4. XDay : Dinâmica focada nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.

  5. Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  6. Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

  7. Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

  8. Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade:

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Marketing and Events Specialist - Brand Experience
description:
SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from a global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on-demand production methodology for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

SHEIN's Brand Experience area is responsible for all the brand's offline activations and sponsorships, creating innovative experiences that bring SHEIN closer to its public in a tangible and memorable way. Among its main deliveries are the pop-up stores, one of the brand's biggest successes in Brazil and around the world.

The SHEIN pop-up concept goes beyond a temporary store; they are true hubs of experience, where fashion, interactivity, and technology meet. Each edition is carefully planned to reflect the brand's identity, featuring a varied product mix, instagrammable spaces, and exclusive activations that create a unique connection with consumers.

As well as providing direct access to SHEIN products, the pop-ups are designed to strengthen relationships with the local public, highlighting cultural elements and regional trends. All of this is in line with SHEIN's commitment to offering fashion that is accessible, diverse, and connected to its consumers' lifestyles.

Main responsibilities:

  1. Management of pop-up stores and events:
    Plan, execute, and manage the operation of temporary stores and other offline events with SHEIN brand activation, ensuring that activities have an impact and strengthen the brand according to the KPIs pursued.
    Coordinate partner suppliers, internal teams, and stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of projects.
    Manage, monitor, and negotiate offline media, including channel selection and out-of-home media, delivering campaign effectiveness.
    Work in partnership with the social media team, ensuring a unified strategy that promotes the customer journey on our platform.
  2. Project management and execution:
    Manage the area's projects so that all stakeholders are directed towards the same strategy.
    Exhibit an autonomous profile and ownership in project management, defining strategy, execution, and measuring results.
  3. Data analysis:
    Possess an analytical profile for evaluating all the area's projects, reach, ROI, brand recognition, customer satisfaction, and target audiences.

Qualifications:

  1. Degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business Administration, Communications, or related field.
  2. More than five years' experience in offline marketing, preferably in the fashion, retail, or marketplace sector.
  3. Experience in managing and executing physical events.
  4. Experience in project management.
  5. Experience in traditional media management.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community, and all types of diversity.

Resumo do trabalho

Pesar os componentes utilizados na composição das massas de borracha, conforme especificação do sistema eletrônico (DMO), separando, medindo os componentes e utilizando-se de balança para a pesagem; observar a quantidade de materiais em estoque, requisitando novos lotes, sempre que necessário; identificar os lotes com as etiquetas apropriadas, visando possibilitar a rastreabilidade.

Operar calandra, retirar material na esteira para abastecimento, desembalar materiais e operar moinhos aberto e fechado, carregando o equipamento para início do processo produtivo após acabamento final da massa, conforme ficha técnica; acomodar as mantas de borracha no carrinho para resfriamento e armazená-las com a OP para utilização em outra máquina; retirar mantas das calandras e auxiliar no corte das mesmas; preparar e operar máquina de corte de mantas, regulando conforme especificações; preencher formulários específicos da área; acionar o termorregulador; efetuar apontamento eletrônico.

Deveres e responsabilidades essenciais

  • Zelar pela confidencialidade das informações sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Zelar pela conservação e integridade dos equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade e informar aos superiores qualquer anormalidade.
  • Manter limpo e organizado o local de trabalho.
  • Conhecer e atuar de forma a atender aos requisitos da Política de Qualidade.
  • Observar, cumprir e fazer cumprir as Normas Internas de Segurança.
  • Observar, cumprir e fazer cumprir as atribuições relacionadas à sua função descritas nos Procedimentos e Instruções de Trabalho de sua área.
  • Observar, cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e regulamentos contidos no Código de Conduta de Negócios da empresa.

Responsabilidades - Pesagem:

  • Separar e medir componentes utilizados na composição das massas de borracha.
  • Pesar os componentes, conforme especificação do sistema eletrônico (DMO), utilizando-se de balança e armazenando os materiais em caixas.
  • Observar a quantidade de material estocado no setor, requisitando novos lotes.
  • Cortar borrachas para serem pesadas ou quebradas em moinho, utilizando-se guilhotina ou instrumento de corte.
  • Utilizar manipulador à vácuo para transportar borrachas, conforme necessidade.
  • Identificar o número do lote da matéria prima, anotando no formulário apropriado.
  • Aferir calibração das balanças, utilizando-se de pesos padrões, conforme procedimento.
  • Deslocar as caixas com os componentes na esteira, até a entrada do setor de Mistura.

Responsabilidades - Mistura:

  • Operar moinhos, ajustando os parâmetros do equipamento conforme especificações das Fichas Técnicas.
  • Retirar material na esteira da pesagem e armazenar no kamban dos moinhos.
  • Escanear os materiais para reconciliar no sistema eletrônico (DMO).
  • Desembalar materiais e colocá-los para misturar.
  • Após processo de mistura, retirar a massa e colocar no elevador do moinho aberto.
  • Realizar a homogeneização do material segundo ficha técnica e abastecer a calandra.

Responsabilidades - Calandra

  • Operar calandra, realizando os ajustes da máquina.
  • Preencher formulários específicos da área.
  • Realizar a limpeza dos equipamentos de acordo com instrução de trabalho.
  • Preparar e operar máquina de corte de mantas, conforme ficha técnica para cada produto, regulando a guia de controle do tamanho da manta, de acordo com a régua e preencher a OP, anotando os dados pertinentes; pesar materiais e preencher o formulário específico quando houver retalhos (sobras) no corte para repasse na mistura.
  • Transportar o carro de inox até a área de armazenamento das mantas prontas.
  • Realizar o apontamento da produção no sistema eletrônico (DMO).
  • Verificar necessidades e prioridade de materiais conforme orientação.

Educação

  • Ensino Médio Completo ou em andamento.
  • FORMAÇÃO: Ensino Regular.

Experiência Profissional

  • Ter atuado em outros cargos operacionais, possibilitando habilidade e familiaridade no desempenho das tarefas.

Conhecimentos, habilidades e habilidades preferenciais

  • COMPETÊNCIAS: Destreza manual, atenção e concentração.
  • OBSERVAÇÕES: A experiência em cargos que possibilitem a familiaridade e habilidade para o desempenho das funções justifica a ausência dos requisitos mínimos de educação e formação.

title: FBA FC Operations Program Manager, FBA - Fullfillment by Amazon
description:
FBA FC Operations Program Manager, FBA - Fulfillment by Amazon

At Amazon Brazil we value Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions, therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve. Our leadership is committed to sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history in Amazon’s Brazil team! Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. Over 2 million Sellers in 10 countries list their products for sale on Amazon. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices.

We are looking for a Program Manager for Amazon to support FBA (Fulfillment By Amazon) Brazil. This position will be based in an Amazon FC and will support the FBA team to manage its operations. This PM will work closely with various stakeholders (Operations, S&OP, Program, Sales, Operations, Transportation, Legal, etc.) to drive strategic and tactical initiatives to improve FBA operations, including Inbound, Outbound and Inventory Management. This position will focus on process improvements across teams, identifying areas of opportunity, mapping processes and proposing optimizations, as well as managing daily operations. He/She will build and own metrics and reports and review performance metrics, being the bridge between FC operations and Business teams.

Key job responsibilities

  • Act as the link between FC Operations and FBA Business teams
  • Identify gaps, pain points and opportunities in the existing processes and propose improvements
  • Dive Deep on issues to differentiate isolated issues from structural ones
  • Own metrics and reports, as well as keeping track of key metrics and initiatives impact
  • Be creative to create solutions that address pain points/opportunities and improve Seller Experience
  • Calculate impact/potential of ideas/pain points, making it tangible
  • Influence and support Product team (both Latam and global teams) on Roadmap prioritization
  • Suggest/create programmatic solutions and initiatives while creating business cases for Product team
  • Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make trade-offs and balance business needs versus technical constraints

About the team

FBA is one key team in Amazon BR. We manage the operations for sellers that send their inventory to our Fulfillment Center (FC) - from collecting their products to delivering them to customers and receiving customer returns. In FBA, we have several teams that manage SX and operations in this business model. Fulfillment Operations is one of the teams and we manage the whole inventory once it's received in the FC: Inventory management, removals, customer returns, reimbursements and operational processes. We are a data-driven team that owns metrics tracking and evolution, maps gaps and implements improvements to impact our sellers and customers.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of program or project management experience
  • 3+ years of working cross-functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
  • 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
  • Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
  • 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
  • Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
  • Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.   • Skills: Strong negotiation and communication skills. Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills. Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite. Ability to analyze market trends and develop effective strategies.

We are seeking a talented GCP Engineer to join our dynamic team.   • Fluent in English – both written and spoken – for collaboration with global teams.

description:
Sobre nós

Somos o maior Grupo de Farmácia Magistral da América Latina, estamos presentes em mais de 10 estados com mais de 125 lojas. Ao diversificar nossa equipe, podemos oferecer melhores soluções para nossos clientes e contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa e inclusiva.

Buscamos talentos que compartilhem dos valores com base no respeito, inovação, desenvolvimento, melhoria contínua e bons relacionamentos.

Se você tem paixão por aprender e colocar em prática o que aprende, trabalha de forma colaborativa, é inovador e gosta de compartilhar ideias e opiniões, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade de crescer e trabalhar em uma empresa que valoriza tudo isso.

Como será seu dia-a-dia

  • Prospecção Ativa de Leads: Realizar contato inicial com potenciais franqueados, identificando oportunidades de negócio e qualificando os leads de acordo com os critérios estabelecidos.
  • Qualificação de Leads: Avaliar o perfil e o interesse dos leads, garantindo que apenas os contatos qualificados avancem no funil de vendas.
  • Gerenciamento do Pipeline: Organizar, priorizar e manter registros detalhados no CRM, acompanhando o status e as interações com cada lead, além de assegurar o cumprimento das metas diárias de contatos e agendamentos.
  • Criação de Abordagens Personalizadas: Desenvolver mensagens, scripts e estratégias de comunicação alinhadas aos perfis dos leads, personalizando abordagens para aumentar as taxas de conversão.
  • Relacionamento com Leads: Construir conexões genuínas com potenciais franqueados, demonstrando os benefícios e a solidez da Farmácia Artesanal. Manter follow-ups consistentes para avançar os leads no funil de vendas.
  • Análise e Relatórios de Resultados: Monitorar métricas de desempenho como taxa de conversão, quantidade de leads qualificados e tempo médio de resposta. Elaborar e apresentar relatórios semanais com insights e recomendações para melhorias.
  • Colaboração com a Equipe de Expansão: Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de vendas e expansão para alinhar estratégias, compartilhar informações sobre os leads e definir prioridades e metas comuns.
  • Atualização e Capacitação Contínua: Estudar o mercado de franquias, tendências e concorrência, participando de treinamentos e cursos para aprimorar técnicas de vendas consultivas e conhecimentos do setor.

O que buscamos em você:

  • Ensino Superior completo ou cursando (administração, marketing, comunicação, gestão comercial ou áreas correlatas)
  • Fluência verbal e escrita;
  • Foco em resultados;
  • Boa administração do tempo.
  • Experiência de 1 a 2 anos como SDR Inside Sales ou consultor de vendas.
  • Experiência em vendas consultivas b2b é essencial preferencialmente no setor de franquias saúde ou negócios de alto ticket.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're looking for a talented and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join Wildlife's Marketing Tech team in São Paulo, Brazil.

Wildlife is one of the largest gaming companies in the world. Besides building amazing games, part of the reason it has been super successful has been its ability to acquire new users more efficiently than other companies. As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll play a key role in our Performance Marketing operations by handling data from millions of users, thousands of campaigns, and dozens of different channels, helping us to solve our most challenging quests. Some of them are:

  • Evolve integrations with several third-party APIs including Ad Networks, MMPs, and other data providers
  • Attribute the users to the marketing campaigns that drove their financial impact;
  • Estimate the lifetime value of our users to measure the long-term return on our Marketing investments;
  • Build the capabilities to run experiments to continuously improve the performance of our creative assets and our Marketing operations;
  • Support the decision-making of our Marketing operations through high-quality data products and well-structured dashboards;

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and culture. The right person for this position is naturally curious, comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, is resilient, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

What you'll do

  • Solve complex and open-ended problems that directly impact one of the most critical areas of the company;
  • Help to evolve and improve the performance of our current solutions and build new data products and systems
  • Be part of a cross-functional team, directly contributing end-to-end to our processes, making sure our products are in production and working properly (final impact);
  • Work in a challenging and fun environment to produce exceptional results.

What you'll need

  • Experience working on designing and developing data-intensive applications in the cloud with technologies such as Spark, SQL, Python, Airflow, etc
  • Excellent high-level communication skills
  • Proficiency in written English

Main Challenges

  • The team is responsible for designing, building, and evolving a big set of complex data-intensive applications including batch data apps, near real-time data ingestion, ML models, and BI pipelines
  • These applications also require the team to build, maintain, and evolve integrations with several third-party APIs including Ad Networks, MMPs, and other data providers used in Digital Marketing
  • As a Senior Data Engineer, you will help the team to ensure high availability, reliability, robustness, performance, cost-effectiveness, and maintainability of the developed solutions
  • We have a multidisciplinary environment and you will interact with people from diverse backgrounds, including Game Engineers, Backend Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Marketing Managers.

More about you

  • You are impact-driven and interested in learning more about adjacent disciplines (e.g.: Backend, Data Science, etc);
  • You like to solve open-ended problems with non-obvious solutions;
  • You communicate in a structured way both speaking and writing, including in English;

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Psyonix is searching for an FX Outsource Artist to support and supervise creative content provided by outsourcing partners. The FX Outsource Artist will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for review. The ideal candidate would be a talented artist who can communicate with outsource partners, including documenting existing pipelines, collecting or creating quality bar and technical example assets, collecting photo references, creating asset block-outs, creating simple block-out paintovers, and finally, packaging all files to send off to the external artists.

In this role, you will

  • Work with the Art Leads and Director level to establish visual direction for our outsourcing vendors
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video references, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors
  • Clearly communicate feedback to the outsource partner, and ensure those creative notes and goals are relayed by internal artists, level designers, game designers, and production to understand the needs and goals of FX being created
  • Need to have a strong sense of weight, timing, motion, and demonstrate technical aptitude with Materials and Logic
  • Train outsource partner artists in Psyonix's specific techniques and best practices
  • Foster the remote teams' enthusiasm for the project
  • Work with internal stakeholders and or IP owners on licensed asset approvals

What we're looking for

  • Experience in shipping AAA titles across multiple platforms
  • Experience shipping high-quality game-ready assets for production, with an emphasis on stylized art / stylized realism
  • Must have a strong portfolio showing executed real-time FX
  • Strong understanding of latest toolsets in game art creation, including (but not limited to) Unreal Engine 5, Substance Painter, Perforce, and 3D modeling packages (A plus if experienced with Houdini, Flow (“Shotgrid”), and Miro)
  • Highly organized, self-driven, customer-focused, and a great team player
  • Ability to critique, mentor, and improve art through written and visual feedback loops
  • A keen understanding of technical hurdles, the ability to autonomously make choices to further art quality, and excellent communication skills are a must
  • Experienced working within a team and a high-pressure production environment

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Job Summary

Coordinates complex discharge planning needs, provides supportive counseling, psycho-social assessments, and interventions for designated patient populations.   2. Manages length of stay through effective discharge planning, proactively addressing barriers.
  3. Provides counseling and advocacy to assist patients and families with adjustment issues.
  4. Considers options such as palliative care and homecare to promote outpatient health.
  5. Monitors risk assessments and implements interventions as needed.
  6. Resolves patient care issues compassionately.
  7. Negotiates care plans with patients, families, and third-party payors.
  8. Communicates with healthcare team and insurance to ensure resource utilization and quality care.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Social Work
  • Less than 1 year experience in an MSW internship program

  • Proficient in management processes and managed care standards
  • Strong analytical skills to measure healthcare processes and outcomes
  • Effective negotiation and influencing skills

Physical Demands

Lift and carry 25 lbs., frequent sitting/standing, keyboard use, and role-specific activities like kneeling, bending, squatting, and CPR.

title: Payments Operations Senior Analyst
description:
EBANX is the leading payment platform connecting global companies with customers from the fastest-growing digital markets in the world.

Since the beginning of our journey, we have had one mission: to provide global access for everyone. We believe that transforming challenges into opportunities and making the impossible part of the journey is crucial! That's precisely why we created a payment technology that builds bridges between people and businesses every day in 29 rising markets across the globe.

We call ourselves ebankers, we are global thinkers, we value diversity, we foster creativity and we work hard to connect businesses and people worldwide through payments. Let's make history together?

EBANX is a high-growth technology and payments company with a solid track record of delivering high value to our customers and more than a decade of local expertise, streamlining merchant expansion in rising Latin American, African, and Asian markets with superior performance, service level, and market presence.

The Business Operations Team is responsible for monitoring and leading improving payment approval rates in over 24 countries, continuously driving merchant performance to the next level. We engage with multiple business areas (Products, Engineering, Fraud Prevention, Growth, Commercial and Merchant services teams) and external stakeholders to deliver superior performance on cards, account-based instant transfers and cash-based vouchers, being the leader in local direct connections to payment players and in the offering of Alternative Payment Methods (APMs).

As an Analyst of the Business Operations Team , your mission is to maintain the integrity of EBANX's payment operations, ensure the best quality of payment approval, build strategic relationships with stakeholders, establish business continuity, identify strategic opportunities to improve EBANX performance and provide technical support to internal and external areas:

You will also be responsible for:

  • Monitor and utilize advanced technical skills to analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) of all pillars of approval rates considering the technical and integration characteristics of each acquirers, issuers, BINs, products, API responses, ISO messages review and design and divisions like recurrent and card on file payments, card verification, installments and pre-authorization;
  • Lead and propose deep-dive actions plan to enhance approval rates at the acquirer, partners, issuers and card schemes, propose and execute actions at country level to improve approvals and conversion rates;
  • Design and develop workflows and procedures to streamline payment operations optimizing efficiency and effectiveness;
  • Build and manage relationships with payments partners (acquirers, issuers, card schemes and external providers) to ensure optimal performance and operations continuity and also collaborate with partners to implement strategies to improve approval rates;
  • Conduct A/B Test with acquirers, focusing on enhancing approval rates and evaluating country approval strategies;
  • Be on top of Market and Technology trends in the payments industry, mapping opportunities and recommendations to improve EBANX payment operations and approval rates and proactively adapt our operational strategies accordingly;
  • Create dashboards visualizations on Kibana/Grafana enabling deeper and specific analysis for conversion rate, such as creating queries for SQL consults and analysis;
  • Analyze real-time data to identify patterns and trends that can enhance the efficiency and accuracy of Smart Routing strategies using advanced Machine Learning (ML) techniques;
  • Detect anomalies and handle alerts based on Machine Learning algorithm and work on the continuous improvement of the monitoring tool, refining the algorithm and dashboards;
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders Products, Engineering, Fraud Prevention, Data Analytics, Commercial, Merchant Operations and Business Architecture to guarantee and deliver the best approval rates to our merchants.

Main requirements for this position:

  • Previous experience in the payments industry, e-commerce or similar;
  • A self-starter who is comfortable working in a fast-paced and data-driven environment;
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets and derive actionable insights;
  • Tenacious and resilient with a positive and solution-oriented attitude;
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and optimization;
  • Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills;

What would be a Plus:

  • Experience in process mapping and technical documentation;
  • Knowledge about smart routing, anti-fraud solutions, card schemes authorization products;
  • Experience with data visualization and analytical tools (Tableau, Kibana);
  • Project management, roadmap and organization;
  • Ability to manage and handle complex situations;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology or related field;
  • Exceptional communication, presentation and negotiation skills;
  • Advanced SQL to write, review and join queries across multiple databases;
  • Advanced English or Spanish;

EBANX offers:

  • Spanish, English, and Portuguese classes;
  • Meal Allowance;
  • Transportation voucher (if needed);
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • EBANX Education: financial support for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs so you can develop important skills for your career;

  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX;
